column1: # The guide corpus sometimes names a step's real target only in prose, or not at
# all. "Journey Abroad" says "visit your nation's embassies" and never names the
# NPC, so the step could only ever degrade to "go to this nation" -- which left
# the player cycling between city entrances with no idea who to talk to.
# A row here binds one guide step to a target that EXISTS in
# ffxi-nav-destinations.tsv. It does not invent a place; it says which catalogued
# place the guide meant. Every row must name its evidence.
